name: performing-container-security-scanning-with-trivy
author: mukul975
description: Scan container images, filesystems, Git repositories, and Kubernetes manifests for OS and language-dependency vulnerabilities, IaC misconfigurations, exposed secrets, and license issues using Aqua Security's Trivy, generating CycloneDX/SPDX SBOMs. Use when integrating vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines, deploying the Trivy Kubernetes operator, or triaging scan results for security operations.
